title: Jackie Robinson's Estate & Bumpboxx Partner To Celebrate The 75th Anniversary Of Jackie Breaking The Color Barrier
htmlContent:
Later this month, Jackie Robinson will partner with Bumpboxx to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Jackie Robinson breaking the color barrier with a celebrity softball game and a home run at Jackie Robinson Field in Los Angeles on July 17th!

“We couldn’t be more pleased that Jack and Rachel’s alma mater is bringing together, so
many greats to remember Jack’s legacy on this 75th anniversary. Onward and upward, as Rachel
always says! Via The Robinson Family," Per the press release.

Participants include Lil Wayne, Mario, Terrell Owens, Michael Vick, Cam Jordan, Chase Claypool, Ryan Leaf, Ricky Williams, and TraeThaTruth. The red carpet event will be hosted by Barbara Sanchez of Elegant PR and the team.

Over 40 celebrities will take the field and honor the great Jackie Robinson! All proceeds will go to Jackie Robinson's estate.

"We’re so excited to have the opportunity to host this event to honor the legend himself, Jackie.
Robinson. Seventy-five years ago, he changed the landscape of sports! His courage was felt just as much off the field. We couldn’t the more excited to bring everyone together on July 17th and pay
homage to the late great Jackie Robinson!"

Bumpboxx® had the privilege to work directly with Jackie Robinson"s estate; as a tribute to the late Jackie Robinson, all the players will be wearing number 42 with Robinson on the back to honor Jackie. Other brands participating in the event include Nike, New Era, Rawlings, Panini, and Stance. To buy tickets and learn more about the event visit bumpboxx.com/Jackie75
